records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for setting up Cedar Ventures on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails [email:9255049c, email:e5e3dd78]. No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, silent admin — unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Cedar Ventures started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking in after your first week with Wrenfield. The usual first step is a project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
